source: NASA Ames Prognostics Center of Excellence (PCoE) Battery Aging Dataset
description: 18650 LiCoO2/Graphite cells repeatedly charged and discharged at room temperature (24°C)

mappingDescription.voltage: Mapped to pack terminal voltage in Volts (V)
mappingDescription.current: Mapped to discharge current in Amperes (A)
mappingDescription.temperature: Mapped to DHT/NTC sensor temperature in °C
mappingDescription.capacityAh: Measured cycle discharge capacity in Amp-hours
mappingDescription.resistanceMohm: Calculated load-step internal resistance in mΩ
